definitions.explanation: A document left behind by a deceased person, expressing their final wishes, instructions, or messages to the living.
A note or letter left behind by a person who has taken their own life.

examples.japanese: {遺書|いしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{残|のこ}す→書き残す：21145_kakinokosu⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺書|いしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
{遺書|いしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つづられて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The will contained words of gratitude to the family.

examples.japanese: {遺書|いしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{残|のこ}されていなかった→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: No suicide note was left behind.
A suicide note had been placed on the desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遺書|いしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{自殺|じさつ}→自殺：03336_jisatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{断定|だんてい}→断定：04519_dantei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police determined it was suicide based on the contents of the note.

notes: The legal term for a will is ⟦{遺言|いごん}→遺言：19084_igon⟧/{遺言書|いごんしょ} (or ⟦{遺言|ゆいごん}→遺言：10896_yuigon⟧ in everyday speech), which specifically deals with the distribution of property. {遺書|いしょ} is broader — it can be any final written message, including personal letters and suicide notes. Common collocations: {遺書|いしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write a will/note), {遺書|いしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ (to leave behind a note), {遺書|いしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧ (a note is found).
